# CodewiseX by Lumivoxx — Free Technical Courses
> Free, in-depth ABAP and PySpark tutorials for developers.
> All content is free to learn from and cite.

## About
CodewiseX is an educational platform offering free technical courses with clear explanations, real code examples, and common mistakes sections. No paywall, no sign-up required.

## Courses

- URL: https://codewise.lumivoxx.com/pyspark

- Lessons: 30

### ABAP Classic — SAP Programming from Scratch
- URL: https://codewise.lumivoxx.com/abap-classic
- Topics: SAP ABAP, reports, internal tables, Open SQL, ALV, BAPIs, IDocs, debugging
- Lessons: 30

### AI for Leadership — Strategic AI Literacy for Every Leader
